evals.prompt: Create `src/views/support-case.view.ts`: a default grid (subject linking to the record, status, priority, owner, due date), a 'My Open Cases' list, a kanban by status, and a simple edit form.
evals.expected_output: One `defineView({ list, listViews, formViews })` container — never a bare flat view object. `data: { provider: 'object', object: 'support_case' }`, `columns` with `link: true` on `subject`, a `listViews.my_open` entry with `filter` triples (`{ field: 'assigned_to', operator: 'equals', value: '{current_user_id}' }`), a kanban entry with the required top-level `columns` plus `kanban: { groupByField: 'status' }` (no top-level `groupBy`), and `formViews.edit` with `type: 'simple'` and `sections` referencing a declared field group.

evals.prompt: Build `src/apps/crm.app.ts`: a Sales group with Leads, Opportunities, the pipeline kanban, a 'My open deals' entry and the sales dashboard; an Approvals group that only shows when approvals are installed; and a second app for the support team.
evals.expected_output: `App.create({...})` with a `navigation` tree of `group` items: `type: 'object'` entries with `objectName`, a `viewName: 'pipeline_kanban'` shortcut, a bare `filters: { owner_id: '{current_user_id}', status: 'open' }` slice for 'My open deals' (no view authored for a one-off), `type: 'dashboard'` with `dashboardName`, and `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'` on the approvals item. Exactly one App per `type: 'app'` package: the support audience is a `requiredPermissions`-gated group inside it, not a second `App.create`. Registered under `defineStack({ apps })`.

evals.prompt: Add a Convert action on `lead` — only for qualified, not-yet-converted leads, from the record header and each list row, launching the `lead_conversion` flow — and a bulk 'Add to campaign' that asks which campaign, for the selected rows.
evals.expected_output: Two `defineAction` items. Convert: `type: 'flow'`, `target: 'lead_conversion'`, `locations: ['record_header', 'list_item']`, `visible: P`record.status == "qualified" && record.is_converted == false`` (bare CEL, never brace-wrapped), `confirmText`, `successMessage`, `refreshAfter: true`. Bulk: `type: 'modal'`, `locations: ['list_toolbar']`, a field-backed `params: [{ field: 'campaign_id', objectOverride: 'campaign', required: true }]`, and a `body` that reads `input.selectedIds`.

evals.prompt: Design a custom lead record page: the Convert action inline in the header, a highlights strip, a stage path over `status`, and the related contacts. Also write a user guide for the `crm` package under src/docs and link it from the nav.
evals.expected_output: `definePage({ name, label, type: 'record', object: 'lead', template: 'three-column', regions: [...] })` with `page:header` (the Action object passed in `properties.actions`, no sibling action node), `record:highlights`, `record:path` (`statusField`, `stages`), `record:related_list`. The guide is a flat, namespace-prefixed `src/docs/crm_user_guide.md` in pure Markdown (MDX and image references are rejected at build), surfaced by a `type: 'url'` nav item pointing at `/docs/crm_user_guide`.

evals.prompt: Sales reps need a locked-down task workbench: only open tasks, sorted by due date, grid only, no switching to other views; plus a report of opportunity amounts by stage.
evals.expected_output: Capability narrowing is the signal for an interface page: `definePage({ type: 'list', object: 'task', interfaceConfig: { source: 'task', columns: [...], sort: [...], filterBy: [...], userFilters: { element: 'dropdown', ... }, appearance: { allowedVisualizations: ['grid'] }, userActions: {...} } })` — the page IS the view definition (no deprecated `sourceView`). The report is `type: 'summary'` selecting `rows` / `values` from a declared `dataset`; there is no `chart` report type.

evals.prompt: Invoice entry as a stepped form — header, then line items, then review — saving the invoice and its lines together.
evals.expected_output: A stepped form over ONE object is `formViews` with `type: 'wizard'` and `sections`, not a screen flow (nothing branches). Line items come from the DATA MODEL: `inlineEdit` on the child's `master_detail` field, which renders the editable grid and saves parent + children in one atomic `/api/v1/batch`; `subforms` only to override derived columns. No custom page, and no 'Add line' button (the ghost row exists).
